theme.text: Public-health authorities and the mainstream vaccine narrative promote a sanitized, dogmatic "truth" about vaccines that ignores or conceals evidence of harm, regulatory capture, and suppression of dissent.

thesis.text: Jefferson County Public Health’s ad repeats long-standing medical dogma that is factually false or misleading; vaccines and their ingredients (including aluminum and thimerosal), regulatory exemptions (1986 Act), and manipulated studies have caused or concealed serious harms (SIDS, autism, chronic disease), and dissenting research and voices have been suppressed or censored.

pillars.label: Public-health Dogma and Censorship
pillars.text: Public-health agencies, local institutions, and mainstream media enforce a pro-vaccine narrative, marginalize dissent, and censor or block venues, letters, and screening events that challenge vaccine orthodoxy.

pillars.label: Regulatory Capture and Liability Shielding (1986 Act)
pillars.text: The 1986 National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act removed liability from vaccine manufacturers, enabling rapid expansion of the childhood vaccine schedule, pharma profit, and a close CDC–industry relationship.

pillars.label: Vaccines and Population Health Trends
pillars.text: The article links the expansion of vaccination programs to increases in SIDS, autism, chronic childhood illnesses, infant mortality anomalies, and other negative population-level health outcomes.

pillars.label: Toxic Ingredients and Safety Testing
pillars.text: Aluminum, thimerosal (ethylmercury), polysorbate 80, formaldehyde and other vaccine ingredients are portrayed as toxic, inadequately safety-tested, and capable of crossing protective barriers and causing neurological and other harms.

pillars.label: Study Manipulation and Cover-ups
pillars.text: Key vaccine-safety studies and agency responses (e.g., CDC handling of MMR/autism and thimerosal data) were manipulated, suppressed, or reworked to hide associations between vaccines and harms.

pillars.label: Local Community Resistance and Information Efforts
pillars.text: Local groups in Port Townsend formed study groups, attempted to screen Vaxxed and publish a vaccine study guide, and encountered local censorship and venue refusals.

theme.text: Public-health authorities and the mainstream vaccine narrative promote a sanitized, dogmatic "truth" about vaccines that ignores or conceals evidence of harm, regulatory capture, and suppression of dissent.

thesis.text: Jefferson County Public Health’s ad repeats long-standing medical dogma that is factually false or misleading; vaccines and their ingredients (including aluminum and thimerosal), regulatory exemptions (1986 Act), and manipulated studies have caused or concealed serious harms (SIDS, autism, chronic disease), and dissenting research and voices have been suppressed or censored.

pillars.label: Public-health Dogma and Censorship

pillars.label: Regulatory Capture and Liability Shielding (1986 Act)
pillars.text: The 1986 National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act removed liability from vaccine manufacturers, enabling rapid expansion of the childhood vaccine schedule, pharma profit, and a close CDC–industry relationship.

pillars.label: Vaccines and Population Health Trends

pillars.label: Toxic Ingredients and Safety Testing
pillars.text: Aluminum, thimerosal (ethylmercury), polysorbate 80, formaldehyde and other vaccine ingredients are portrayed as toxic, inadequately safety-tested, and capable of crossing protective barriers and causing neurological and other harms.

pillars.label: Study Manipulation and Cover-ups
pillars.text: Key vaccine-safety studies and agency responses (e.g., CDC handling of MMR/autism and thimerosal data) were manipulated, suppressed, or reworked to hide associations between vaccines and harms.

pillars.label: Local Community Resistance and Information Efforts
